commits_data.title: RTPS: Updated dissector to be compliant with the DDS Security 1.2 spec
commits_data.message:
RTPS: Updated dissector to be compliant with the DDS Security 1.2 spec

Made the following changes to the rtps dissector:
1. Only the first element is mandatory, the other ones are optional and may be
   missing.
2. Added the new user_endpoints_default_required_mask field to the symmetric
   cypher algorithm.
3. Half of the bit mask, bits 16 to 31, are now reserved for custom algorithms.
